purpose: ONS mid-2023 UK resident population by single year of age (0 to 89 and 90 and over) and sex (MYE2). Consumed by the SPI income stage, which draws each SPI 2022-23 donor's age within its published AGERANGE band in proportion to these single-year populations instead of uniformly, with State Pension recipients drawn at or above State Pension age (microcosm#1069).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
